besluite.rede: A relative clause placed after the verb is normal Afrikaans and here can only refer to 'opstal'; splitting it is a lateral move.
Same standard extraposed relative clause, clearly tied to 'dorpie'; the split only reads differently and repeats 'dorpie'.
'Vars grond' contrasts naturally with 'uitgeboer', and 'nuwe grond' would put 'nuwe' twice in one clause before 'n nuwe dorpie'.

besluite.fout: 'Hulle' follows two sentences about sorghum and millet ('albei') and so first points to the grains.
